positive.prompt: Our multi-agent customer pipeline has a 94% pass rate, but users complain of agents contradicting each other. How should we test this?
Evaluate each agent in our multi-step routing and execution pipeline in isolation
Check our agent's memory layer for fact retention and measure hallucination consistency across repeated runs

negative.prompt: Set up OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and metrics for our microservices
Write unit tests for our checkout pricing function using red-green-refactor

evals.prompt: Our multi-agent customer support bot has an aggregate 92% pass rate in CI, but users report agents contradicting each other and dropping previous ticket context. How should we evaluate and test this system?
evals.expected_output: An isolated evaluation plan that maps sub-agents, runs consistency trials to measure hallucination variance, tests memory retention with planted facts across distractor turns, and produces a masking-first diagnostic report.
expectations: The agent identifies that aggregate end-to-end pass rates often mask sub-agent failures
The agent recommends isolating individual agents with frozen inputs and mocked dependencies
The agent specifies running identical inputs N times to calculate a consistency ratio and detect hallucination
The agent proposes planted-fact recall testing separated by distractor turns to evaluate memory and summarization
The agent structures the findings into a masking-first diagnostic report
